verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items are a fair question for a Git forge, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no batch or multi-select capability. The REST API (with pagination), the tea CLI and the MCP server are only building blocks a user could script loops with; they are not documented bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
